name.es: Mesa fija de tilt sobre tornillo de tierra (pilote helicoidal)

description.en: Fixed-tilt ground table on hot-dip galvanized steel helical ground screws, screwed into the soil and fitted with a top connection (nut cage with set screws). Three manufacturers list 3-inch (76 mm) round shafts in 1.4 to 2.9 m lengths; the table frame and module clamps sit on top of the screws.
description.es: Mesa fija de tilt sobre tornillos de tierra helicoidales de acero galvanizado en caliente, atornillados en el terreno y con conexión superior (jaula de tuerca con tornillos de fijación). Tres fabricantes listan ejes redondos de 3 pulgadas (76 mm) de 1,4 a 2,9 m; el bastidor y las mordazas de módulo se apoyan sobre los tornillos.

typical_use: Ground arrays on soils suitable for screw installation, and where ramming is restricted or access is limited.
applicable_standards: ASTM A153 (friction bolts, as stated by one supplier)
DIN 933 (friction bolt, as stated by one supplier)

geometry.description: Ground screw modelled as a vertical post of 1600 mm overall length, the length stated by two manufacturers. Thread (flighted) length, installed depth and top connection geometry are not modelled beyond the values sourced. Table frame position is not sourced.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module row, y up-slope/north-south horizontal, z up; origin at ground/roof contact of first support; mm and degrees

elements.note: Overall length 1600 mm, thread length 600 mm (Terrasmart). Vertical orientation is a convention for modelling.

reference_layout.note: Screw lengths stated by Terrasmart: 1425, 1600, 2100, 2380, 2600 and 2900 mm (thread length 600 mm; one 2900 mm model with 1400 mm thread). BDI product listings titled 60 in (1.5 m), 78 in (2.0 m) and 98 in (2.5 m); the reviewer did not verify the exact overall lengths of the BDI models beyond the 60 in listing.

grounding_bonding: Not stated in the sources reviewed for the screw itself; the screw is galvanized steel and can be bonded through its top connection (placeholder accessory).
installation_notes: Maximum installation torque: 6547 N m for 3 in (76 mm) screws and 9066 N m for 4.5 in (114 mm) screws (American Ground Screw specification, using a calibrated torque motor).
BDI recommends a maximum installation torque of 5000 ft-lb (about 6779 N m, converted by the reviewer).
Downward installation force must not exceed 5 % of the allowable axial compression load of the shaft or threads, whichever is lower (American Ground Screw specification).
Friction bolts are tightened snug-tight plus a quarter turn (American Ground Screw specification).
Terrasmart notes approximately 20 in (508 mm) of shank exposed in its bending-moment calculation; this is a source assumption, not a design value.
Screws are installed by machine and suitable for soils that allow screw installation; soil and pull-out testing is an engineering task and is not covered by the sources.
